issue.body:
Recent update to python 3.14 has caused some nixos tests using `os.system` to fail.

I've replaced the failing items, internal usage, as well as patches we introduce in nixpkgs.

Tested all of the nixos tests, except `usbrelay` because I don't have such a hardware.

Known failure `nixosTests.ghostunnel-modular` fixed in https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/541269
Known failures for modular services fix is here https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/540857

-    os.system(f'update-source-version microsoft-edge "{version}"')
